sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message. Our proposed terms are in the term sheet of this message.
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Your defect rate was 2376 ppm in 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
Could you confirm ppm commitment of at most 1500?
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Hello,
thank you for your mail, we are very happy to hear from you!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.
To be fully transparent with you:
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
As to the index change and quality record data you cited, we see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.
Hi there, we checked your numbers and can do the 1500 ppm you asked for, but we need €46.50 to make it work with the extra quality checks.
We don't really do detailed cost breakdowns, but as your own index shows, labor costs are going up and that hits us.
We dropped our price to show we want this business, so let's get this moving.
Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We are ready when you are!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the news data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. We can drop to €46.50 for the 300 ppm, but we really need you to pay us faster. The news about our restructuring is true, so getting paid quicker is our main focus right now.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. 

So our current Angebot is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
